description: This file contains test cases for the WhatsApp configuration accessors, focusing on resolving merged allowFrom and defaultTo properties, as well as normalizing allowFrom entries. It relies on functions imported from 'config-accessors.js' and uses the 'vitest' testing framework.

methods.name: resolveWhatsAppConfigAllowFrom
methods.description: Resolves the 'allowFrom' entries for a given account ID within the provided configuration.

methods.name: resolveWhatsAppConfigDefaultTo
methods.description: Resolves the 'defaultTo' property for a given account ID within the configuration.

methods.name: formatWhatsAppConfigAllowFromEntries
methods.description: Normalizes an array of 'allowFrom' entries for WhatsApp configuration.
